mapper.select: SELECT MAIL_ACCT_SQ, MAIL_ADDR, ACCT_USE, RGST_EMPLY_ID, DATE_FORMAT(RGST_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS RGST_DT FROM TB_EEP_MAIL_ACCT_M ORDER BY MAIL_ACCT_SQ
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_MAIL_ACCT_M (MAIL_ADDR, ACCT_USE, APP_PW_ENC, RGST_EMPLY_ID, RGST_DT) VALUES (#{MAIL_ADDR}, #{ACCT_USE}, #{APP_PW_ENC}, #{RGST_EMPLY_ID}, NOW())
